posts.zh:
dsh-any-background 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。一个主题外观插件，让你完全自定义 Web 端的主题色、背景壁纸，以及主页分部位精细的透明度与模糊度控制，还可导出导入主题设置进行分享。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-69b93336c97ac8c3ebba.html
posts.en:
dsh-any-background is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. A theme appearance plugin that lets you fully customize the Web UI with custom theme colors, background wallpapers, and fine-grained transparency and blur controls for each section of the homepage, plus import/export support for easy theme sharing.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-69b93336c97ac8c3ebba.html
